notes.title: Instant Death 1.02 Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, thanks for the support and good words. Huge thanks to [b]Markiplier[/b] for the video :)

In case you didn't see it;

https://youtu.be/5Fl-EF5uf7M
	[h1]Changelog	[/h1]
[list]

 [*]You can quick restart the game by pressing "R" when you die.

 [*]Save bug on some levels fixed.

 [*]Frame rate improvement.

[/list]
